official_sources.title: Xiaohongshu Share Open Platform
official_sources.finding: Client SDK flow into Xiaohongshu App publishing UI; not a server publish grant.

official_sources.title: Xiaohongshu Share SDK iOS guide
official_sources.finding: Application registration, AppKey, permission review, and Universal Link are required.

official_sources.title: Xiaohongshu Share SDK Android guide
official_sources.finding: Application/package information and an issued AppKey are required.

official_sources.title: Xiaohongshu Share SDK FAQ
official_sources.finding: The SDK opens the App quick-publish flow; automatic title and caption filling is restricted.

official_sources.title: Xiaohongshu Mini Program certification rules
official_sources.finding: Mini Program onboarding is organization-qualified and does not evidence generic creator note publishing.
